summary: The profile names a mailbox stream's store work after the upgrade (fence, report, replay, primary, rollout, attachment, own-post and loss checks) and the commit-driven maintenance loops, which appeared as unlabeled worker threads

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change. The work each stream and loop does is unchanged; only its profile and doctor --performance labels are new.

recovery.detail: An older build records the same work as unlabeled again.
